Maya (CEO): Quick weekly note — short list of wins and risks from my side. TL;DR: hosted growth steady, Private beta on track, one infra risk to watch.

Maya (CEO): Metrics snapshot: ARR motion: +7% w/w on paid signups, latency P50 @ 42ms (hosted), errors bumped to 0.9% last 48h from a deployment pattern.

Maya (CEO): Priorities this week: 1) finish Private EU beta rollout gating items, 2) reduce error budget by 50% on high-volume models, 3) validate cost targets on top 5 customers.

Ravi (VP Eng): Noted. The error bump mostly correlates with last Friday's kernel change on runtime. Working on a targeted rollback + canary tweak. Will post a short RCA by EOD.

Jordan (VP Product): Thanks — product will pause new canaries for two days. Also we should surface affected routes in Console (token-level) so SEs can triage faster.

Lina (Head of Growth): Customer-facing note: we’ll delay the EU private beta announcement by 24h to avoid messaging during the mitigation window. Need a short rollback-friendly marketing blurb if we clear.

Sam (SRE): infra-bot shows two alerts around model-serving queue growth at 03:12 UTC and 03:46 UTC. I mitigated with extra reserved capacity in dedicated clusters. Keeping an eye.

infra-bot: [deploy] maya/runtime-kernel-3.4.1 -> production at 2026-03-22T03:07:12Z. Canary 10% rolled.

Ravi (VP Eng): Plan: 1) revert last kernel patch on non-critical fleets; 2) increase KV cache grace for 6 hours; 3) run targeted regen on failing requests. If rollback reduces errors, we'll freeze kernel change and re-evaluate perf tradeoffs.

Maya (CEO): Good. Please keep execs looped. If rollback is needed, coordinate a short all-hands with oncall + product + growth to agree messaging.

Jordan (VP Product): Re: Private EU beta — product readiness checklist shows three outstanding items: audit log retention, KMS integration smoke tests, and single-tenant onboarding docs. Dev owners assigned.

Lina (Head of Growth): I'll hold the announcement and prepare a soft invite list for existing partners. Also prepping an FAQ for latency/cost expectations.

Sam (SRE): Will post timeline for rollback attempt and expected SLO impact window. Also opening a follow-up incident thread with traces.

Maya (CEO): One leadership ask: heads up your teams that any feature enabling new inference-heavy customers should be gated behind a go/no-go from Eng + SRE this week. We can't let capacity surprises slip.

Ravi (VP Eng): Acknowledged. We'll gate feature flags and add a perf checklist to PR templates.

Maya (CEO): Final note on hiring & runway: hiring pace remains steady; runway extension looks achievable if we hold to the cost targets from Optimize. Sharing a short deck in a follow-up message. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Lina (Head of Growth): Thanks — will align growth experiments to the cost guardrails.

Maya (CEO): Thank you all. If anything urgent pops, ping me directly. Otherwise we'll reconvene next Monday for the regular weekly sync. :thumbsup:
